no-error-details-in-response.notes: Tracks catch-clause params and error-first callback params into res.send/json sinks via a scope frame stack.

no-host-header-in-links.notes: Tracks req.headers.host / req.get('host') assignments into URL construction and mail sinks within a function — conservative same-scope flow, not a name match.

no-missing-cors-check.notes: Migrated from browser-security — checks Express/Koa/Fastify server-side patterns

no-missing-csrf-protection.notes: Migrated from browser-security — checks Express/Koa/Fastify server-side patterns

no-missing-security-headers.notes: Migrated from browser-security — checks Express/Koa/Fastify server-side patterns

no-sensitive-data-in-query.notes: Token-based matching of sensitive parameter names on req.query reads — names are the signal, so ships as warn per I3.

no-static-root-exposure.notes: Fires on express.static/serveIndex argument shapes (__dirname, '.', process.cwd(), traversal segments, non-literal joins).

no-user-controlled-redirect.notes: Fires on res.redirect(req.query.*) AST shape — structural, not naming heuristic. Passes litmus test: rename res/req and it still fires.

no-user-controlled-render-locals.notes: Fires on the res.render(view, req.body|query|params) AST shape incl. spreads. The shape carries the signal, but the request/response roots are matched against fixed name sets (req/request/ctx, res/response/reply), so an unconventional alias is not tracked.

require-case-insensitive-path-guard.notes: Protected-path detection keys off configurable path literals (admin/api/dashboard/...), so it ships as warn.

require-query-type-guard.notes: String-method call on a req.query member with no typeof/Array.isArray/String() guard in scope; ships as warn while cross-function flow is untracked.

no-disabled-helmet-protections.notes: Fires on helmet({ <protection>: false }) option shapes (CSP/frameguard/noSniff/referrerPolicy/hidePoweredBy, helmet 6 and 7 spellings).

require-strict-transport-security.notes: Fires on the hsts/strictTransportSecurity option and the helmet.hsts() factory — disabled, max-age below floor, includeSubDomains false.

no-unsafe-csp-directives.notes: CSP directive literals: 'unsafe-inline'/'unsafe-eval'/wildcard sources, frame-ancestors '*', missing frame-ancestors under useDefaults:false, upgradeInsecureRequests:null.

no-permissive-trust-proxy.notes: Fires on app.set('trust proxy', true) / app.enable('trust proxy') — req.ip becomes client-controlled (CWE-348).

require-route-authentication.notes: Route-path vocabulary decides what counts as a critical function, so it ships as warn per I3. Structural around it: registration shape, middleware chain, principal read in the handler.

no-client-controlled-authorization.notes: Structural half is req.body/query/params/headers/cookies member reads in a decision position; the authorization-attribute vocabulary (role/permission/userId) is the name-based half, so it ships as warn per I3.

no-idor-resource-access.notes: "Handler never reads the principal" stands in for "no ownership check", and the lookup-method list is name-based — ships as warn per I3.

lock-file.deprecated: Use CI tooling instead — this checks filesystem for lock file existence, not AST analysis

no-dynamic-algorithm-selection.notes: crypto.createHash/Hmac/Cipher with dynamic first arg. Attacker controls algorithm = downgrade attack. Static literals are already checked by no-weak-hash-algorithm.

no-dynamic-command-string.notes: Shell binary + -c/-Command argv position with an assembled string, or a non-escaping command-runner (execaCommand/$.raw). Distinct from no-shell-injection (CWE-78 exec concat).

no-template-injection.notes: Fires on Handlebars/EJS/Pug/Mustache/Nunjucks .compile()/.render() with dynamic first arg. Zero rules covered template injection before this.
